Replaced the blanket 'no runtime helpers or parsers' rule, which ~500 exported functions contradict, with the rule the package follows: pure, environment-free helpers over a module's own shapes (no Node built-ins, filesystem, network or process access; time as a parameter, fleet-routing-receipt's now default being the limit; only published Kontour dependencies), one implementation each, never copied or wrapped in shared. Checked contracts src for node: imports and environment access; matches docs/reference/contracts.md ownership rules. The shared guidance-assets copy that dropped provenance is the cited drift (#2722).
